changes.text: Season summary (On Demand KPI Block): the coach or analyst compares the team’s observed season PPP with the modeled average for the selected Top-K plays. The summary shows their difference and each play type’s share of recorded offensive possessions. It uses one regular season and a selected opponent; it does not offer last-5 or last-10-game windows because the source contains season totals.

For Beta, the season summary appears directly on Matchup and Data Explorer. The coach summary follows the completed Run Baseline selection, including Top-K and the offense/defense weights. The analyst chooses one offensive team and a separate opponent; this view uses the top five plays with 70/30 weights. Table search and preview filters do not change the full-season totals. Changing the matchup clears old values. Missing data has a clear message, and failed requests have a retry option. The summary is labeled as a historical comparison, not measured improvement or a forecast.

The Beta season summary is covered by suite BST-294 and cases BST-295 to BST-299. All five passed local checks for calculations, missing or invalid input, role access, both screens and result refreshes. The source checks include 25 summary API tests and 48 client/UI tests. With TOR against BOS in 2024-25, both roles showed 0.969 observed PPP, 1.009 modeled PPP and a +0.040 PPP difference; the selected plays used 38.3% of 8,517 recorded offensive possessions. A stopped local API showed a retry message and recovered after restart. The live release (e085b3b) then passed 81 API checks and 13 browser checks for the selected flows. Jira keeps the results for BST-295 to BST-299 and passing retests for BST-313 and BST-314. The matching use-case flow, API design, screen states and validation links are published in VP revision 88.
